strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. Elshank destroyed
Ez-8, launching.
I'm heading out too, to cover the Elshank.
Right.
Hey, wait for me, everyone!
Don't get too worked up and hurt yourself, okay? Joe!
Leave it to me!
Ronin, thank you for carrying the dangerous Kirhasium all this way...
Joe and I are close friends. It's the least I can do.
Princess, the Elshank is ready
for micro-worm navigation!
Commander Hazuki.
All right, all units launch and keep watch on the surrounding area.
Domon... I wonder if everyone's okay?
No telling. It's been a long time since we came down to Earth.
We might...have to go back up someday too.
First time since we launched the HLV. That was rough...
Commander, don't let your guard down.
The things you least want to happen are the ones that happen again.
Captain Amuro, please don't scare me.
Back in the Argama days, that always happened to Bright.
That's right, Elpeo Ple's aboard the Elshank too, isn't she?
Yes. She hasn't woken from her coma. She keeps murmuring Judau's name...
So I figured sending her to Judau would be best.
Shaff, how long until launch?
About...five more minutes.
Damian! You're riding with that naive princess, so guard her
and do it right!
Akira! If it comes to it, stop that colony with the God Bird!
Space, huh... Daisuke, say hi to Tetsuya and Boss for me.
Dammit... I wanna help out too...!
Koji...
Daisuke, once the fighting on Earth is over, I'll head to space too.
Tell Koji that for me.
Tetsuya...
Sure, I'll pass on everyone's regards.
More than anything... I'll pull this off, even if it costs my life...!
Daisuke, your radiation wounds may have healed, but don't overdo it.
And Maria, please look after Daisuke.
Leave it to me.
If it comes to it, my brother and I will blast the enemy away together!
I don't think that's what he meant.
That spirit's just right, Hayato. ...Considering what's ahead.
Yes, I'll fight with all I've got. ...Well, Father, see you.
...Daisuke, everyone... I'm counting on you.
It doesn't really feel real, you know? A colony falling on us...
True... But...
We can't afford to have it feel real.
Lieutenant Amada.
You two are way too relaxed. It's at times like this the enemy...
They're here! Geez, Shiro! Why'd you have to say that!?
It's my fault!?
When they come, they come!
So they intend to send that ship into space.
At this timing, they can't reach the colony before its point of no return...
I can't see their aim, but that ship is mine...!
They still had this many forces hidden away!?
That Gouf... It's here again!? I hate it, it's so strong.
Yeah, the 07 Custom, Type B3...
Anyone piloting that has to be a real oddball, or...
...an ace. Troublesome...!
But if that Gouf's here... maybe Aina is too...!
Three more minutes! Keep the enemy out of the lab at all costs!
Last time it was when the Elshank came down.
Now we get attacked on the way up...!
We have to deal with the ones in the water...!
Guess I'll go wild with Getter-3!
Dammit, Raideen!
Wait, Akira! Leave this to me!
Don't be shaken by a petty ambush like this.
...Numbers like these... I'll smash them all at once!
I must settle this...before Lady Aina arrives.
She is someone who...should no longer be riding in such a thing.
Heh... Splendid... Lady Aina, this is farewell.
...The path you chose, the war you chose...
I pray with all my heart...that your spirit never breaks, to the very end...
Norris! Norriiis! Eject! There's still time!
...With all my heart... ...I pray......
Hmph! You do well with such a patchwork of old models...!
Ngh, I can't lose...!
I'll win this fight... and spend my life with Aina...!
What! So you're the one...!?
We're in the middle of a battle!? What are you...
Lieutenant Amada! Don't lose yourself in battle!
Don't end up like me...and him...!
Heh... Fuhahaha! Lady Aina... I have found...a place to die...!
What! Sherman... and Bancs! At a time like this!
It's like they were waiting for this!?
Princess!
...They likely detected the energy from our micro-worm navigation.
Joe...!
Leave it to me! ...Is what I'd like to say... but we're badly outnumbered.
Those are...the aliens' unmanned robots. Good timing or bad... Blast it.
You're not getting in our way now...! You stupid puppets!
With them this spread out... this is bad, Koji!
Dammit, they just keep coming! I'd love to crush them all at once, but...!
Looks like we'll have to take them out one by one.
Mike! Can't you back us up!?
Easy for you to say, Lenny!
Banjo! At this rate, we're gonna get wiped out!
Relax, Beauty. If we'd go down to something like this...
...then that's all we were ever worth.
Banjo, you can't just say that...!
That said! Finding a way through is our job! Let's go!
Hey, Show!
You heard Banjo. ...We just have to find a way. Let's go!
I won't make it! Ngh... Tobikage...!
Hm, that robot is...!
...Tobikage!
Tobikage!
Here it comes, here it comes! It's a ninja!
What's a ninja?
Hmm, I don't know.
Maybe on the surface, machines that appear out of nowhere are "ninjas"...
Heh, true. Just like Schwarz, it appears out of nowhere,
and vanishes before you know it.
Now that you mention it, that's true.
Anyway, it's on our side!
Ah, that ninja robot...!
See? When things work out, they work out.
I see, so that's why you were so calm, Banjo!
Geez! You could've told us first!
Banjo, you knew!?
...W-Well, sort of.
Don't fall for it, Big Bro Akira. He was totally just making it up.
Well, never mind that. Thanks for the help, Ninja Warrior!
Good timing! I'm counting on you...!
All right, we'll beat them with mobility!
Don't you lose, Show! Marvel!
Princess Romina, the Elshank is ready to launch...!
...Emergency launch...! Commander Hazuki, we're off.
Princess Romina, we're counting on you...!
They're off... It's up to you, Daisuke...
The colony drop... Stop it, whatever it takes.
1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Norris...!
That's... a Zaku head...!
That mobile armor... the one Lieutenant Amada...?
The Apsaras. Lady Aina, this is earlier than planned...!
Nngh, this is all because I failed you!
Norris... You're safe!
Yes, Lady Aina.
...If I'd had my way, you would never have boarded that again...!
Screw it! Bring on as many as you want!
A few more machines won't make a difference. I'll crush every last one...!
...I can only conclude Zeon has a base somewhere else.
But...
Is Aina really in that machine...?
Aina!
Shiro... Shiro Amada!
Aina... I hate Zeon...!
But... since the day we met in space... I haven't been able to forget you!
...Shiro.
Lieutenant Amada!? What on earth are you...?
Commander Hazuki, let's leave this to him. This isn't our place.
Aina! If this is war... is there really nothing we can do!?
No! There must be something we, of all people, can change!
This is no time for us people of Earth to be fighting each other! Aina!
Shiro... I'll fight too. Alongside you. ...Norris... I'm sorry.
Aina...
Ainaaa!
Ugh...
Aina...?
Shiro...
Aina, come with me...
Yes...
Commander Hazuki. She's from Zeon, but she can be trusted.
I vouch for her! Please, take her aboard...
Commander, I'm asking too. ...A chance like this doesn't come often.
Captain...?
Hmm. Very well... I'll allow it...
Thank you... Shiro.
Lady Aina...
Norris... I'm sorry. I...
...No, you chose well. You are no longer Lord Ginias's puppet...
Follow the path you believe in. But... I am a soldier!
Norris...!?
Not for my own sake... nor for the Sahalin family...
I am a soldier of Zeon to the very end. Please stand back, Lady Aina.
Next time, I will have to fire...
...Norris... Norris!
Heh heh... To meet the one Lady Aina loves... It has been an interesting life.
Norriiis!
...For the sake of those doomed to perish. My role, too, ends here.
Colonel Norris!
Hmm... You're... I see, from the Cyclops Team...
For the sake of those doomed to perish...!
Our leader Steiner said the same thing... and died...!
But you've still got something you have to do, don't you!?
You know what you have to protect,
so is throwing it away to die what makes a soldier cool!?
That's just wrong!
Bernie...
Just as I thought... You're the Cyclops Team's washout.
Ngh...!
But... it seems Steiner's eye for people was not mistaken.
Heh... To think I'd be talked down by such a youngster.
Norris...!
Acquired skill "Lucky".
...Norris.
Colonel... you were a soldier of Zeon... to the very end...
But... this... this is just...!
Good, that settles it.
Princess Romina, the Elshank is ready to launch...!
...Emergency launch...! Commander Hazuki, we're off.
Princess Romina, we're counting on you...!
They're off... It's up to you, Daisuke...
The colony drop... Stop it, whatever it takes.
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
For a while there, I didn't know what would happen...
We've confirmed the Elshank's warp in the stratosphere.
Now... all we can do is watch over them...
Man, so much happened, my head's spinning.
Princess Romina... I hope she's all right.
Princess Romina's tougher than she looks, so she'll be fine.
That's right. All we can do now is watch...
That's right. Whatever happens, happens.
It might sound irresponsible... but that's all we can do.
We'll just have to trust them. And just like them...
we've got plenty of things we need to do ourselves.
Right. Commander Hazuki, let's head to the next point.
Indeed. Also, the Combattler team just contacted us.
Oh, so they're okay. What did they say?
It seems they've found the Campbellians' hideout.
So they did have a secret base on the surface.
No way they could've moved so fast otherwise.
Looks that way. Seems we're not out of the woods yet.
But I'm sick of always being a step behind in this fight.
...This time, it looks like we can make the first move.
Yeah! Let's show 'em what we've got!
Stormy weather, any way you look at it.
...But it looks like we'll just have to keep pushing on like this to the end.
